## Basic Functions
You can use R as a basic calculator 

```{r}
dataset <- data.frame(age = c(17, 17, 17, 17, 34, 18, 15, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 85, 21, 58))
```

## Install packages

```{r}
if (!require(c("tidyverse"))) install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
```
